reading.body:
This record is not a data center. It is an office of Factory Software, an Italian reseller and systems integrator for AVEVA, a publicly traded industrial software company listed on the London Stock Exchange.

The entry was tagged as a data center in OpenStreetMap but appears to be a mistag of the office's own IT infrastructure. AVEVA Select is the branding AVEVA uses for its network of regional partner offices that sell and support its engineering design, operations management, and asset-performance software to manufacturing, energy, and process industries. Factory Software operates as a local reseller entity under this program. A software reseller's office maintains its own business IT systems but does not operate a data center capable of serving external workloads.

This means the facility contributes nothing to the grid constraint on AI compute. It neither houses servers for training or inference workloads nor draws significant power for that purpose. The mistag in OpenStreetMap highlights a common hazard in mapping infrastructure: identifying business IT closets as data centers inflates apparent facility counts and can obscure what actually exists on the ground.
